entries.title: Zonal Coordinator — Southwest Zone D
entries.description: Emerged as Zonal Coordinator in 2026 for the 2026–2027 tenure, representing students across Southwest Nigeria and coordinating advocacy for student welfare.

entries.title: Police partnership on student safety
entries.organization: NANS Southwest · Zone 11 Police Command, Osogbo
entries.description: Led the zone's executives on a visit to the Assistant Inspector-General for Zone 11, offering to work with the police on peace and security in Osun and Oyo and naming student sensitisation as a priority.

entries.title: Safety of prospective corps members
entries.description: Co-signed the zone's statement on reported ransom demands for abducted prospective NYSC members, calling for verified communication with families and safer, risk-sensitive deployment.

entries.title: Student safety during the Osun election
entries.description: Co-signed the zone's warning against election-related violence on Osun campuses, calling on government and security agencies to guarantee student safety and on politicians not to recruit students.

entries.title: Press statements from the Coordinator's desk
entries.description: Issued statements on student housing rents, extortion of students, midnight WAEC exams, welfare at OAU and LAUTECH, and the rescue of abducted students.

entries.title: Advocacy for reliable campus electricity
entries.description: Led a public demonstration calling attention to unreliable electricity across campuses and student communities, and its effect on academic life.

entries.title: Assistant General Secretary
entries.description: Served as Assistant General Secretary in 2025, advocating for student welfare and transparent communication between students and the executive council.
